items.text:
Just unfinished, Zero quality of life, a fantastic idea that I was very excited for, But since I bought the game in early access, the game hasn't really improved since then

You spend the majority of time at 16x speed waiting for your character to uninstall a piece of tech, that you may or may not be able to sell
items.text_zh:
就是没做完，零生活质量改进，一个我曾非常兴奋的绝妙点子，但自从我在抢先体验阶段买了这游戏以来，游戏真的没什么改进

你把大部分时间花在16倍速等待你的角色卸载一件科技，而你可能卖得掉也可能卖不掉

observations.description: 大部分时间以16倍速等待角色卸载科技部件
